phases.title: Fix sort parameter parsing in queryParser.ts to accept hyphenated format
phases.notes: Added HYPHEN_TO_CAMEL map in queryParser.ts to normalize price-asc/price-desc/rating-desc to camelCase before validation. Fixed pre-existing TS type collision by using Omit<ProductQuery, 'sort'> in both queryParser.ts and productService.ts, and removed unused Product import. Build now passes; 16/18 tests pass (2 remaining failures are phase-2 envelope field names).

phases.title: Fix response envelope field names in productService.ts (count→total, pages→totalPages)
phases.notes: Changed return statement in productService.ts line 44: `count` renamed to `total` and `pages` renamed to `totalPages`. All 18 tests now pass and build succeeds.
